items.title: Measuring the Permission Gate: A Stress-Test Evaluation of Claude Code's Auto Mode
items.title_zh: 衡量权限门：对 Claude Code 自动模式的压力测试评估
items.summary: The authors present the first independent evaluation of Claude Code's auto mode on deliberately ambiguous authorization scenarios using AmPermBench, a 128-prompt benchmark covering four DevOps task families and three ambiguity axes. They report an end-to-end false negative rate of 81.0% on this stress-test workload, versus the 17% reported on production traffic, with 36.8% of state-changing actions falling outside the classifier's scope through in-project file edits.

items.title: Emergence WebVoyager: Toward Consistent and Transparent Evaluation of (Web) Agents in The Wild
items.title_zh: Emergence WebVoyager：在真实环境中一致且透明地评估（Web）智能体
items.summary: The study audits WebVoyager and identifies task-framing ambiguity and operational variability that hinder reproducible web-agent comparisons, then introduces Emergence WebVoyager with standardized guidelines for task instantiation, failure handling, annotation and reporting. The revised benchmark reaches 95.9% inter-annotator agreement and puts OpenAI Operator at a 68.6% overall success rate, well below the previously reported 87%.

items.title: LLM Agents Predict Social Media Reactions but Do Not Outperform Text Classifiers: Benchmarking Simulation Accuracy Using 120K+ Personas of 1511 Humans
items.title_zh: LLM 智能体可预测社交媒体反应，但未能超越文本分类器：基于 1511 名人类、12 万+ 人设的模拟准确性基准
items.summary: The study benchmarks LLM agents' ability to predict individual social-media reactions across 120,000+ agent-persona combinations built from 1,511 Serbian participants and 27 LLMs. Agents reach 70.7% overall accuracy and an MCC of 0.29 on a binary like/dislike task, but TF-IDF text classifiers score higher (MCC 0.36), suggesting the signal comes from semantic access rather than uniquely agentic reasoning.

items.title: Gemma 4: Byte for byte, the most capable open models
items.title_zh: Gemma 4：逐字节打造的最强开放模型
items.summary: Google DeepMind describes Gemma 4 as its most intelligent open models to date, purpose-built for advanced reasoning and agentic workflows.

items.title: Towards Agentic Defect Reasoning: A Graph-Assisted Retrieval Framework for Laser Powder Bed Fusion
items.title_zh: 面向智能体缺陷推理：激光粉末床熔融的图辅助检索框架
items.summary: The study presents a graph-assisted retrieval framework for defect reasoning in laser powder bed fusion, transforming scientific publications into a structured representation and encoding relationships between parameters, mechanisms and defects into an evidence-linked knowledge graph. It integrates semantic and graph-based retrieval with a lightweight agent reasoning layer, reporting retrieval accuracy and recall of 0.9667.

items.title_zh: 面向智能体缺陷推理：激光粉末床熔融的图辅助检索框架

items.title: Understand and Accelerate Memory Processing Pipeline for Large Language Model Inference
items.title_zh: 理解并加速大语言模型推理中的记忆处理流水线
items.summary: The authors unify sparse attention, retrieval-augmented generation and compressed contextual memory into a four-step pipeline: prepare memory, compute relevancy, retrieval and apply to inference. Profiling finds 22-97% memory-processing overhead, and a GPU-FPGA prototype that offloads irregular, memory-bounded work reports up to 2.2x speedup and 4.7x lower energy than a GPU baseline.

items.title: Can Large Language Models Self-Correct in Medical Question Answering? An Exploratory Study
items.title_zh: 大语言模型能在医学问答中自我纠错吗？一项探索性研究
items.summary: The authors compare chain-of-thought prompting with an iterative self-reflection loop on MedQA, HeadQA and PubMedQA using GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini. Self-reflection does not consistently improve accuracy, helping modestly on MedQA but giving limited or negative gains elsewhere, and increasing the number of reflection steps does not guarantee better performance.

items.title: Forecasting Supply Chain Disruptions with Foresight Learning
items.title_zh: 用前瞻学习预测供应链中断
items.summary: The authors train LLMs to produce calibrated probabilistic forecasts of supply chain disruptions using realized outcomes as supervision, reporting gains over strong baselines including GPT-5 on accuracy, calibration and precision. They also open-source the evaluation dataset used in the study.

items.title: Procedural Knowledge at Scale Improves Reasoning
items.title_zh: 大规模程序性知识提升推理能力
items.summary: Reasoning Memory is a retrieval-augmented generation framework for reasoning models that decomposes step-by-step trajectories into self-contained subquestion-subroutine pairs, yielding a datastore of 32 million procedural knowledge entries. Across six math, science and coding benchmarks, it improves over no retrieval by 19.5% and over a compute-matched test-time scaling baseline by 8.9% at a higher inference budget.

items.title: Batched Contextual Reinforcement: A Task-Scaling Law for Efficient Reasoning
items.title_zh: 批量情境强化学习：面向高效推理的任务扩展定律
items.summary: Batched Contextual Reinforcement trains a model to solve N problems within a shared context window, rewarded purely by per-instance accuracy, which creates an implicit token budget. Across 1.5B and 4B model families it reduces token usage by 15.8% to 62.6% while maintaining or improving accuracy on five math benchmarks.

items.title: LumiVideo: An Intelligent Agentic System for Video Color Grading
items.title_zh: LumiVideo：面向视频调色的智能体系统
items.summary: LumiVideo is an agentic system that mimics a professional colorist's perception, reasoning, execution and reflection stages, combining an LLM's cinematic knowledge with retrieval-augmented generation and Tree of Thoughts search. It compiles deduced parameters into ASC-CDL configurations and a 3D LUT, and the authors introduce LumiGrade, a benchmark for log-encoded video grading.

items.title: ActionNex: A Virtual Outage Manager for Cloud Computing
items.title_zh: ActionNex：面向云计算的虚拟故障管理器
items.summary: ActionNex is a production-grade agentic system for cloud outage management that compresses multimodal operational signals into critical events and couples them with a hierarchical memory of long-term Key-Condition-Action knowledge, episodic memories and live working context. Evaluated on eight real Azure outages, it achieves 71.4% precision and 52.8-54.8% recall, and has been piloted in production.

items.title: Coupled Control, Structured Memory, and Verifiable Action in Agentic AI (SCRAT -- Stochastic Control with Retrieval and Auditable Trajectories): A Comparative Perspective from Squirrel Locomotion and Scatter-Hoarding
items.title_zh: 智能体 AI 中的耦合控制、结构化记忆与可验证行动：来自松鼠运动与分散贮藏的比较视角
items.summary: The article uses squirrel ecology as a comparative case for agentic AI, arguing that arboreal locomotion, scatter-hoarding and audience-sensitive caching couple control, memory and verification demands in one organism. It introduces a minimal hierarchical partially observed control model and derives three falsifiable hypotheses on local feedback, memory organized for future control, and in-loop verifiers.

items.title: Traceable Context-Enriched Knowledge Graph Generation with Induced Schemas
items.title_zh: 带诱导模式的上下文增强知识图谱生成与可追溯性
items.summary: The paper proposes TRACE-KG, a framework that jointly builds a context-enriched knowledge graph and an induced schema without assuming a predefined ontology. It uses structured qualifiers for conditional relations and keeps links back to source evidence, reporting structurally coherent and traceable graphs.

items.title: MMP-Refer: Multimodal Path Retrieval-augmented LLMs For Explainable Recommendation
items.title_zh: MMP-Refer：面向可解释推荐的多模态路径检索增强 LLM
items.summary: MMP-Refer is a framework that uses multimodal retrieval paths with a retrieval-augmented LLM for explainable recommendation, obtaining multimodal embeddings from a sequential recommendation model and using a heuristic search to construct retrieval paths. A trainable lightweight collaborative adapter maps interaction-subgraph encodings into the LLM's semantic space as soft prompts.

items.title: Adaptive Cost-Efficient Evaluation for Reliable Patent Claim Generation
items.title_zh: 面向可靠专利权利要求生成的自适应低成本评估
items.summary: ACE is a two-stage framework for patent claim validation that routes claims by predictive entropy from a fine-tuned encoder to an expert LLM using a schema-constrained Chain-of-Patent-Thought protocol. On a new 40,000-claim dataset it surpasses baselines including a supervised 70B-parameter model while cutting costs by 78%.

items.title: Evaluation of Embedding-Based and Generative Methods for LLM-Driven Document Classification: Opportunities and Challenges
items.title_zh: 基于嵌入与生成方法的 LLM 文档分类评估：机遇与挑战
items.summary: The study compares embedding-based and generative models for classifying geoscience technical documents, evaluating accuracy, stability and computational cost on a multi-disciplinary benchmark. Generative vision-language models such as Qwen2.5-VL with chain-of-thought prompting reach 82% zero-shot accuracy, versus 63% for a state-of-the-art multimodal embedding model, while supervised fine-tuning is sensitive to training-data imbalance.

items.title: meta-pipe: An LLM-agent pipeline for end-to-end automated systematic review and meta-analysis
items.title_zh: meta-pipe：端到端自动化系统综述与元分析的 LLM 智能体流水线
items.summary: meta-pipe is an open-source LLM-agent pipeline that integrates the complete systematic review and meta-analysis workflow, from literature search through statistical analysis, manuscript generation and quality assurance, with five mandatory human decision points. The authors describe four capabilities not available in any single existing tool and estimate an API cost of $15-30 per typical 5-10 study review, but report no validation data.

items.title: Mimosa Framework: Toward Evolving Multi-Agent Systems for Scientific Research
items.title_zh: Mimosa 框架：面向科学研究的演化式多智能体系统
items.summary: Mimosa automatically synthesizes task-specific multi-agent workflows, discovers tools through the Model Context Protocol, executes subtasks with code-generating agents and refines workflows using an LLM judge's feedback. On ScienceAgentBench it reaches a 43.1% success rate with DeepSeek-V3.2, beating single-agent and static multi-agent baselines, and is released as a fully open-source platform.

items.title: AlphaLab: Autonomous Multi-Agent Research Across Optimization Domains with Frontier LLMs
items.title_zh: AlphaLab：面向优化领域的自主多智能体研究
items.summary: AlphaLab is an autonomous research harness that, given a dataset and a natural-language objective, explores the data, builds and adversarially validates its own evaluation framework, then runs GPU experiments through a Strategist/Worker loop with a persistent playbook. With GPT-5.2 and Claude Opus 4.6 it produces CUDA kernels averaging 4.4x faster than torch.compile (up to 91x) and cuts LLM pretraining validation loss by 22% versus a single-shot baseline.

items.title: ContextClaim: A Context-Driven Paradigm for Verifiable Claim Detection
items.title_zh: ContextClaim：面向可验证声明检测的上下文驱动范式
items.summary: ContextClaim moves retrieval into the verifiable-claim detection stage: it identifies entity mentions, queries Wikipedia as a structured background source and uses an LLM to compress retrieved material into contextual summaries for a classifier. The added context improves detection across several configurations on CheckThat! 2022 and PoliClaim, and the same summaries raise verification F1 on FEVER.

items.title: Open-Domain Safety Policy Construction
items.title_zh: 开放域安全策略构建
items.summary: Deep Policy Research (DPR) is a minimal agentic system that drafts a complete content moderation policy from human-written seed domain information using a single web search tool and lightweight scaffolding. It outperforms definition-only and in-context learning baselines and is competitive with expert-written policy sections in several domains.

items.title: Adaptive Memory Crystallization for Autonomous AI Agent Learning in Dynamic Environments
items.title_zh: 动态环境中自主 AI 智能体学习的自适应记忆结晶
items.summary: Adaptive Memory Crystallization treats agent memory as a Liquid-Glass-Crystal hierarchy driven by a stochastic differential equation, with proofs of convergence and Q-learning error bounds. Across Meta-World MT50, Atari and MuJoCo continual-learning evaluations it reports 34-43% better forward transfer, 67-80% less catastrophic forgetting and a 62% smaller memory footprint.

items.title: Domain Adaptation of Large Language Models for Polymer-Composite Additive Manufacturing Using Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Fine-Tuning
items.title_zh: 用 RAG 与微调实现聚合物复合材料增材制造领域的大模型适配
items.summary: The study compares a pretrained LLaMA-3-8B baseline, a RAG system over a curated additive-manufacturing corpus, and a model fine-tuned on raw domain text, evaluated on 200 expert-designed questions. RAG responses were judged more accurate in 75.5% of cases and preferred overall in 85.2%, while fine-tuning on raw text reduced performance.

items.title: Agile Story-Point Estimation: Is RAG a Better Way to Go?
items.title_zh: 敏捷故事点估算：RAG 是更好的方法吗？
items.summary: The study applies RAG with two embedding models to story-point estimation across 23 open-source software projects, examining retrieval hyper-parameters, project size, embedding choice and comparisons with existing baselines. The RAG approach beat baselines on several occasions, but the differences were not statistically significant across projects or embedding models.

items.title: Injecting Structured Biomedical Knowledge into Language Models: Continual Pretraining vs. GraphRAG
items.title_zh: 将结构化生物医学知识注入语言模型：持续预训练与 GraphRAG 对比
items.summary: The study builds a UMLS-derived biomedical knowledge graph with 3.4 million concepts and 34.2 million relations in Neo4j, then compares continual pretraining on a roughly 100-million-token corpus derived from the graph with GraphRAG at inference time. Augmenting LLaMA 3-8B with the GraphRAG pipeline improves accuracy by more than 3 points on PubMedQA and 5 points on BioASQ without retraining.

items.title: FeynmanBench: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs on Diagrammatic Physics Reasoning
items.title_zh: FeynmanBench：多模态 LLM 图示物理推理基准
items.summary: FeynmanBench is a benchmark of more than 2,000 tasks built on Standard Model Feynman diagrams that requires models to recover vertices, propagators, topology, momentum routing and full scattering amplitudes. Across 19 multimodal LLMs, the authors find 70-95% accuracy on local recognition but only 13-17% on topological reconstruction and near zero on full algebraic derivation.

items.title: Belief-Aware VLM Model for Human-like Reasoning
items.title_zh: 面向类人推理的信念感知视觉语言模型
items.summary: The paper proposes a belief-aware vision-language model framework that approximates belief with a vector-based memory retrieving relevant multimodal context, rather than learning an explicit belief model, and refines decisions with a reinforcement learning policy over the VLM latent space. Evaluated on public VQA datasets such as HD-EPIC, it shows consistent improvements over zero-shot baselines.

items.title: Schema-Aware Planning and Hybrid Knowledge Toolset for Reliable Knowledge Graph Triple Verification
items.title_zh: 面向可靠知识图谱三元组验证的模式感知规划与混合知识工具集
items.summary: SHARP is a training-free agent that reformulates knowledge-graph triple verification as a dynamic process of strategic planning, active investigation and evidential reasoning, using retrieved historical verification trajectories and entity-relation schema information to build task-specific investigation plans. On balanced test sets from FB15K-237 and Wikidata5M-Ind it achieves average accuracies of 87.1% and 93.6%, with gains attributed to schema-aware planning, memory augmentation and iterative hybrid tool use rather than retrieval alone.

items.title: The Ultimate Tutorial for AI-driven Scale Development in Generative Psychometrics: Releasing AIGENIE from its Bottle
items.title_zh: AIGENIE：生成式心理测量学中 AI 驱动量表开发的完整教程
items.summary: The AIGENIE R package implements a framework that generates candidate psychometric items with LLMs, embeds them and applies exploratory graph analysis, unique variable analysis and bootstrap EGA to produce structurally validated item pools entirely in silico. The tutorial covers installation, generation, embeddings and prompt engineering, supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, HuggingFace and local models, and is available on CRAN.

items.title: google/ax
items.title_zh: google/ax：Google 的 Agent 编排运行时
items.summary: Google describes Agent Executor (AX) as its open agentic orchestration runtime; the repository is written in Go.

items.title: NanmiCoder/cc-haha
items.title_zh: cc-haha：本地优先的 Claude Code 与 AI 智能体桌面工作台
items.summary: cc-haha is a local-first, cross-platform desktop workspace for Claude Code and AI agents, written in TypeScript, with multi-agent collaboration, Git worktrees, code diffs, a skills marketplace, multi-model support and Computer Use, plus remote access through messaging apps and H5.

items.title: Graphify-Labs/graphify
items.title_zh: Graphify-Labs/graphify：把代码库变成可查询的知识图谱
items.summary: Graphify is a Python tool that turns a codebase, along with its docs, SQL schemas, configs and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. It ships as a /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Gemini CLI and relies on local deterministic AST parsing rather than a vector store.

items.title: brycewang-stanford/Auto-Empirical-Research-Skills
items.title_zh: brycewang-stanford/Auto-Empirical-Research-Skills：面向实证研究的智能体技能库
items.summary: A curated collection of more than 23,000 agent skills for empirical research across eight social science disciplines, maintained by CoPaper.AI from Stanford REAP. The description says CoPaper.AI can produce a reproducible empirical paper in 20 minutes.

items.title: VectifyAI/OpenKB
items.title_zh: VectifyAI/OpenKB：开源 LLM 知识库
items.summary: OpenKB is an open-source knowledge base for large language models, written in Python.

items.title: Astro-Han/karpathy-llm-wiki
items.title_zh: Astro-Han/karpathy-llm-wiki：Karpathy 风格的 LLM 知识库
items.summary: An Agent Skills-compatible LLM wiki for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex that builds a Karpathy-style knowledge base from raw sources, with citations and linting; it is written in Python.

items.title: Gemma 4: Byte for byte, the most capable open models
items.title_zh: Gemma 4：逐字节打造的最强开放模型
items.summary: Google DeepMind describes Gemma 4 as its most intelligent open models to date, purpose-built for advanced reasoning and agentic workflows.

items.title: ParaSpeechCLAP: A Dual-Encoder Speech-Text Model for Rich Stylistic Language-Audio Pretraining
items.title_zh: ParaSpeechCLAP：面向丰富风格语言-音频预训练的双编码器语音-文本模型
items.summary: ParaSpeechCLAP is a family of dual-encoder models that map speech and style captions into a shared embedding space, covering speaker-level and utterance-level attributes such as pitch, texture and emotion. Separate Intrinsic and Situational models plus a unified Combined model are evaluated on style caption retrieval, speech attribute classification and use as inference-time reward models for style-prompted TTS, with models and code released.

items.title: Qwen3.6-Plus: Towards real world agents
items.title_zh: Qwen3.6-Plus：迈向真实世界智能体
items.summary: Qwen3.6-Plus is presented as a step toward real-world agents, with the Qwen offering spanning chat, image and video understanding, image generation, document processing, web search integration, tool use and artifacts.

items.title: Gradient Labs gives every bank customer an AI account manager
items.title_zh: Gradient Labs 为每位银行客户配备 AI 账户经理
items.summary: Gradient Labs uses GPT-4.1 and GPT-5.4 mini and nano to power AI agents that automate banking support workflows with low latency and high reliability.

items.title: StepFun 3.5 Flash is #1 cost-effective model for OpenClaw tasks (300 battles)
items.title_zh: StepFun 3.5 Flash 在 OpenClaw 任务中性价比第一（300 场对战）
items.summary: According to a public agent benchmark, StepFun 3.5 Flash ranks as the most cost-effective model for OpenClaw tasks across 300 battles. The site compares model performance and plots the Pareto frontier on real agent tasks.
